verdict.rationale: Bitwarden is a password manager, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so being an MCP client that plugs in other MCP servers is outside its product category. The evidence shows only the opposite role: an official Bitwarden MCP server that exposes the vault to agents. That server-side capability belongs to a different story and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
